text: Concerning: Or, against | their king: Or, Melcom
thy flowing valley: Or, thy valley floweth away
turn back: Or, they are turned back
till they have enough: Heb. their sufficiency
appoint me: Or, convent me in judgment
fainthearted: Heb. melted | on the sea: Or, as on the sea
get you far off: Heb. flit greatly
wealthy: Or, that is at ease
utmost corners: Heb. cut off into corners, or that have the corners of their hair pulled
